runs.text:
DRAGONY is a Symphonic Power Metal band from Vienna, Austria. DRAGONY was founded in 2007, and has so far released three full-length albums ("Legends" in 2012 , "Shadowplay" in 2015 and "Masters of the Multiverse" in 2018) as well as an anniversary EP titled "Lords Of The Hunt" to celebrate the 10 year anniversary in 2017.

The band has shared the stage with many genre greats in the past such as BLIND GUARDIAN, GAMMA RAY, TWISTED SISTER, SONATA ARCTICA, FREEDOM CALL, FIREWIND and many more, and released their fourth studio album "Viribus Unitis" in January 2021 via Napalm Records.

Currently, the band is working on their 5th studio album, scheduled for release in late 2024 via SPV Steamhammer.
